verdict.rationale: Ledgy shows some building blocks: documents attached to cap table transactions, custom cap table views and reports, and segmented permissions for team members and financial reporting. Nothing in the evidence shows a data room, or sharing with external counsel or investors in a diligence-ready format. Missing for 10: a dedicated data room feature, permissioned external sharing with counsel and investors, bundling of documents with cap table views for diligence, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
